articles.summary: Named The World's Best Bar in 2023, SIPS brings its signature creations to Caesars Palace from Oct. 31 through Dec. 31 as the resort celebrates 60 years Caesars Palace is welcoming one of the best bars in the world this fall in tandem with the resort’s 60th anniversary celebrations. Known for its outstanding mixology, carefully selected ingredients and clever presentation, SIPS Drinkery House will take over VISTA Cocktail Lounge from Oct. 31 through Dec. 31 and give guests the sip of a lifetime. articles.title: Caesars Palace Welcomes Barcelona's SIPS Drinkery House for a Two-Month Las Vegas Pop-Up

articles.summary: New campaign featuring football legend Clay Matthews highlights the transformation of the Caesars Sportsbook app through years of product enhancements Caesars Sportsbook has a confession to make heading into football season: it’s had some work done. Caesars Sportsbook Has “Had Some Work Done” Ahead of Football Season Quite a bit, actually. To spread the word, Caesars Sportsbook is launching a new advertising campaign featuring Clay Matthews, who appears noticeably different after “having some work done” himself. In a series of spots, Matthews proudly embraces a dramatically enhanced new look inspired by today’s makeover and “looksmaxxing” trends while showcasing a Caesars Sportsbook app that has gone through a transformation of its own. The spots use Matthews’ over-the-top makeover to spotlight how much the Caesars Sportsbook app has changed in recent years. articles.title: Caesars Sportsbook Has “Had Some Work Done” Ahead of Football Season
